claims.counts: Target word/check totals count repeated executions across fixtures, slots and passes, not distinct numerical values or exhaustive domain coverage. Only three independently authored input programs are used.
claims.observer: Only the codebox delta fixture has a direct right-plane observer;294912 checked words preserved every input bit, including signed zero.
claims.optimization: Every fixture is an identical-ELF control. Timing fields describe whole callbacks; no speedup, per-operation saving, hard deadline or current instrument utilization is inferred.
claims.outputs: Complete on-device output buffers were numerically/PCM and raw-bit compared between the two same-image slots; independent mathematical cache checks and their raw-bit diagnostics are recorded per profile. Full target waveforms were not downloaded.
claims.recovery: Application-only tests restore the identified instrument to runner-verified compiled defaults, unpaused50. Parameter metadata is declared values verified by runner, not raw reply transcripts; phase restarts.
claims.surface: Eleven exact patcher spellings were individually executed and two authored codebox programs separately executed. Canonical/alias equality does not grant coverage to other aliases, overloads, arbitrary codebox or Gen/gen~.
claims.truth: Python independently regenerates each complete INPUT and binary32 ORACLE cache; S3 SHA matches are mandatory. Mathematics uses binary64 operations rounded once to binary32 and explicit previous INPUT history. Operation signed-zero differences are diagnostics under the declared contract; every observed difference was zero.

compile_epochs.ABS_metadata_guard_epoch_note: ABS compiled before a wrong-catalog-kind rejection was added; exact valid ABS configuration and generated-header bytes are unchanged. Root archived the original51 sources separately.
